{{Top|leg}}
The '''reference database''' was a module that provided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a library of technical schematics. The droid could have then drawn upon the information to dismantle or repair various technological items.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
